transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?
I'm here because I've been struggling with an intense, overwhelming fear of heights. It has become a really big issue for me, so I decided it was time to seek some help.
Do you avoid places like balconies, bridges, or high floors because of this fear, or has it caused problems in your daily life?

Yes, I completely avoid those places; I won't go near balconies, high floors, or drive over bridges at all. I constantly have to go far out of my way to avoid them, which has caused major disruptions and restrictions in my daily life and work routine.
When you are exposed to heights or even think about them, do you feel immediate intense fear or physical symptoms like a racing heart, shaking, or dizziness?

Yes, absolutely. Just the thought of being in a high place makes me incredibly anxious and nervous. When I actually have to face heights, I immediately panic and my heart starts racing and I begin to tremble.
How long have you had this fear of heights? Has it been present for 6 months or longer?
Yes, I've had this severe fear for about two years and three months now. So it has definitely been going on for much longer than six months.
